#: Wording of the checks, section "policy": the update rules on their own. Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the check: keep them spelled exactly, or the line is shown raw. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored.
policy.hHelpers: the helpers the verdicts stand on
policy.hNoTransport: the rules are free of transport
policy.hVerdicts: the verdict and the reason, page by page
policy.importsNothingOutward: nothing of the network, MO2 or the disk is imported
policy.briefCarriesDate: a named file carries its date in words
policy.limitHonoured: the limit on newer files is honoured
policy.matchedByNameNotId: an archive matched by name when the fileID is missing
policy.newerListedNewestFirst: newer files are listed newest first
policy.newestNamed: the newest file of the page is named
policy.noTimeInName: a name with no moment in it - no date
policy.ruleAllOldMainRenamed: all ours in Old, Main newer under another name - an update
policy.ruleFreshArchiveOldBuild: a fresh archive downloaded, the mod built from the old one - DOWNLOADED-NOT-INSTALLED
policy.ruleGogIsSibling: a GOG build is a sibling, not an update
policy.ruleHotfixInUpdate: a hotfix in Update - an update
policy.ruleNoVersionCompare: versions are not compared: newer by date within the same role
policy.ruleNothingMarkedMainNewer: nothing marked as downloaded, Main newer than the archive - REUPLOADED
policy.ruleNothingMarkedNoDates: nothing marked and no dates - CANNOT-MATCH
policy.ruleNothingNewer: ours is the newest Main, the rest is history - UP-TO-DATE
policy.ruleOtherRoleInMain: a file of another role in Main - CANNOT-MATCH
policy.ruleOursInOldNoReplacement: our file is in Old files with no replacement - CANNOT-MATCH
policy.ruleSameVersionMinutesApart: the same version minutes later is a neighbour of one release
policy.ruleTextureSizeIsNotVersion: a 4K file is no update to a 2K one
policy.ruleVrIsNotSe: a VR build is another role, not a sibling to be passed over
policy.stampInWords: a moment turns into a date
policy.stampOfNothing: no moment - no date, and no failure
policy.timeFromNameEpoch: the moment out of the archive name: epoch
policy.timeFromNameIso: the moment out of the archive name: ISO
policy.title: the update rules, without MO2 and without Nexus
policy.versionDropped: the version is dropped from the role
policy.whyArgsAreDates: the reason carries its substitutions, not a finished phrase
policy.wordOrderDoesNotMatter: the order of words in a name does not change the role
